problem_method_evidence_contract: Keep problem observations, functional hypothesis, implemented treatment, direct paired outcome and deployment evidence distinct. A positive final F1 difference does not validate every proposed mechanism.

If an arm is effective, retain all five-domain/per-ID initial and final F1 changes, the matched branch comparison, actual beta trajectories and scalar compilation proof, full graph/package sizes, raw input/resource bindings and all costs. Report losses as well as gains.

outcome_actions.dynamic_only_historical_floor_pass: Retain dynamic as a candidate component for later fair strong-reference review; not PAS or matched-QV superiority.
outcome_actions.static_only_historical_floor_pass: Retain static; do not rescue dynamic to satisfy preference.
outcome_actions.both_pass: Higher final macro wins; exact tie static. Dynamic necessity is not implied by both being viable.
outcome_actions.both_fail: Close this fixed parity/ratio/24beta/wide-budget recipe. Pairwise superiority below floor remains limited functional evidence, not a usable framework.
outcome_actions.implementation_or_budget_failure: Report quality missing and all actual costs. Do not convert failure to quality negative or silently restart a variant.
